'''Pau'con''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Rallt]] in the [[Ralltiir system/Legends|Ralltiir system]], located in the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Pau'con was a barren rock with two [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Ralltiir system/Legends|Ralltiir system]], except [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], were designed for the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Ralltiir star system in grid square L-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
